sources.label: Morphe patches for mpvEx. Unofficial, not affiliated with Morphe or the mpvEx de
sources.author: kyurem39
patch_list: Prevents mpvEx from requesting audio focus or reacting to audio focus changes.

Translates the subtitles of the videos you play into a language you choose, including subtitles embedded in the video file. The on/off switch and the target language live in the kyurem39's patches settings panel.
Translates the application interface into Vietnamese.
